svg.title: BugBuster pipeline overview
svg.desc: Reads go through quality control, then read-level taxonomy, ARG and functional profiling, assembly with binning into MAGs, and contig-level ARG, taxonomy, mobile-element and functional branches; every stage feeds the run summary. Solid green boxes run by default, dashed boxes are switched on by a parameter.
svg.text: Metagenomes from reads to results: quality control, taxonomy, assembly and MAGs, antimicrobial resistance genes at read, contig and bin level, functions, and a run report

g.text: genome equivalents, for copies per genome (both functional branches)
per sample, or co-assembly: all or by group

svg.text: optional, switched on by a parameter
Default run: fastp + bwa-mem3 + Nonpareil → sylph → MEGAHIT per sample → run summary. Parameters: docs/parameters.md
